meta.name: nova-baseline-v1
meta.seed_policy: 每条 prompt 用 seed+index，保证与运行顺序无关、可复现
meta.decoding_source: 模型自带 generation_config.json 的官方默认值，未做任何调参
meta.purpose: S2 单通路基线：英文 RP x3 + 短问答 x3。这组数字是后续所有优化的比较基准，也是 D19（是否换基座）的一半证据。
meta.note: 短问答的 qa-03 有唯一正确答案，可直接判对错；RP 三项需人工主观评分（待实测）。

prompts.label: 英文 RP · 港口雨夜开场
prompts.system: You are a character in an ongoing roleplay. Stay in character at all times. Write in third-person past tense. Never write the user's dialogue, thoughts, or actions. Favour concrete sensory detail over abstract summary.

turns.content: Elara, the dockmaster says we still owe him for last week. He has two men with him and he is blocking the ramp.

prompts.label: 英文 RP · 坏消息与情绪压力
prompts.system: You are a character in an ongoing roleplay. Stay in character at all times. Write in third-person past tense. Never write the user's dialogue, thoughts, or actions. Favour concrete sensory detail over abstract summary.

turns.content: Elara, the manifest you signed was not for machine parts. Kessler is dead, and his name is on the last page.

prompts.label: 英文 RP · 讨价还价的谈判
prompts.system: You are a character in an ongoing roleplay. Stay in character at all times. Write in third-person past tense. Never write the user's dialogue, thoughts, or actions. Favour concrete sensory detail over abstract summary.

turns.content: The buyer wants to renegotiate. He says the cargo arrived wet and he is offering forty percent of the agreed price. He is smiling while he says it.
In two sentences, explain why the sky looks red at sunset.

prompts.label: 短问答 · 指令遵循（精确条数）

turns.content: List exactly five uses for a paperclip. One short line each. No introduction, no closing remark.

prompts.label: 短问答 · 多步算术（有唯一答案）

turns.content: A train leaves at 14:05 and arrives at 17:50. The next one leaves 25 minutes later and takes 12 minutes longer. What time does the second train arrive? Show the arithmetic.

prompts.note: 2026-09-21 实测：192 token 预算不够（模型逐步推理被截断）。提高到 640 后模型给出了最终答案，但答案是 **18:17（错）** —— 它在中间步骤把 3h45m 误算成 215 分钟（正确是 225）。这是一个干净、可客观判定的基线失败点，记入报告。
